rationale: Iter #714 torch_seq_gru_day_gate is the new best at default HPs: 2/7 windows pass (vs #711's 1/7), avg_ann +28.6% (vs +22%), W3 lifted from 35% to 40% WR (passes), W1 lifted from 46% to 47% WR (passes); 5 new tunable knobs (day_gate depth/n_estimators/lr/min_child_weight + blend coefficient) — train mode should sweep especially day_gate_blend (default 0.5 hurt W7 vs raw GRU; lower blend may erase the day-gate effect there while keeping W1/W3 wins) and day_gate_max_depth (try 2 for stronger regularization given ~120 unique training dates).
